headline: Volatile Sectors Keep the Front Under Fire
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the ledger shows the struggle narrowing into fewer but sharper sectors. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest watch, with 44 base events in 24 hours and three more in the latest two-hour window; its five Warden, one Colonial, and three neutral bases leave the line unsettled, while casualties and enlistments accelerate. Nevish Line has cooled in event volume to 42 from 54, yet two fresh events and accelerating casualty rates keep its seven Warden, one neutral, and no Colonial bases under scrutiny. Marban Hollow has quickened to 19 daily events, including two in the latest watch, with three Warden, three Colonial, and two neutral bases. Linn Mercy retains a fierce 16-event tally and accelerating losses on both sides, holding two Warden, eight Colonial, and one neutral base. Kuura Strand has eased to nine events, though six arrived in the past six hours. Stonecradle records five events, including two recent ones, amid two Warden and seven Colonial bases. Elsewhere, most sectors report no base movement and markedly quieter fighting.
